LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAll: Remove every treatment condition from every pawn
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAllDesc: Do this, and deconstruct the machines and burn unit beds, before you take this mod out of a colony. Then save and switch the mod off.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveNeedsGame: Load a colony first: there are no pawns to change in the main menu.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveDone: Removed {COUNT} treatment conditions. Save the game before you switch the mod off.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusSwitchedOff: Switched off, so nobody gets oxygen from it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoBed: Not against a bed it can serve. Build it touching a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoOxygen: Out of oxygen: waiting for canisters or a connected oxygen pipe.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusWaiting: Waiting for a patient who needs oxygen.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNotNeeded: Breathing well enough without it: {PATIENTS}. Oxygen starts if breathing weakens, or after smoke or fumes.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedSwitchedOff: Blower switched off, so nobody gets air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNoPower: Waiting for power for its blower. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedWaiting: Waiting for a patient with open burns.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNotNeeded: No open burns on {PATIENTS}, so no air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygenPlain: Clears carbon monoxide about {TIMES} times faster, and eases low breathing.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygen: Carbon monoxide half-life on this oxygen: {MINUTES} minutes, against about {ROOMAIR} on room air. Eases low breathing, up to normal.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipBreathingOnly: Eases low breathing, up to normal. It is room air, so it does not clear carbon monoxide faster.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreCold: Kept cold, so none of its oxygen boils away.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreNotFilling: Taking in no oxygen until its power is back: it can't keep more cold. It still gives out what it holds.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_ChamberNoSurgery: {PATIENT} has an operation waiting, which can't be done inside the chamber. Move them to a hospital bed for it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_GravshipLetterText:
D'thorga Medical Equipment is running without Vanilla Gravship Expanded, which its oxygen pipes and canisters come from. Five of its pieces only exist with that mod: the bedside oxygen stand, the field oxygen kit, the hyperbaric chamber, the oxygen electrolyser and the liquid oxygen store.

Without it you still have the oxygen concentrator, the burn unit bed, silver burn dressings and the manual resuscitator. Vanilla Gravship Expanded needs the Odyssey expansion.

This letter is shown once.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingGravshipOn: Vanilla Gravship Expanded is active: every piece of equipment is available.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingGravshipOff: Vanilla Gravship Expanded is not active, so the bedside stand, field oxygen kit, hyperbaric chamber, electrolyser and liquid oxygen store are off. It is strongly recommended, and needs the Odyssey expansion.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreBoilingOff: Waiting for power for its cooler: until then about {SHARE} of its oxygen boils off and is vented each day.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalAirwayShut: {PATIENT}'s airway is shut, so no air or oxygen can reach the lungs. The airway must be opened first.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalNoDevice: {PATIENT} needs breathing help, but there is no field oxygen kit or manual resuscitator within reach.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalNotNeeded: {PATIENT} is breathing well enough without help.
